name: Mash, the drive-thru worker
source: potatobrawl/mash, Kid vs Dad 02 panels 12 and 14 (storyboards/series/kid-vs-dad/02-food-at-home/DESIGN.md section 3)
personality: Spud's everyday friend who never looks up (Jonny's pick, 12 Nov 2026). Tall, slouched, always on his phone; he misses what happens right in front of him, and that is what starts the trouble. Catchphrase, in gibberish with the same subtitle every time: "One sec."
voiceNote: gibberish (a proposal until Jonny has heard it)
notes: Mash at the drive-thru window: his charcoal hoodie, no neck headphones (phones false), a worker's headset with a mic boom on his right (costume.headset, costumes-crew.js). The paperhat is a prop the clip puts on him.
